summary.headline: Venus in Planetary Houses
summary.text: Astrological judgments for Venus in the houses of Jupiter, Mars, the Sun, Venus, and Mercury, contrasting nocturnal and diurnal nativities and describing effects on wealth, women, marriage, disputes, sexuality, and social relations.
